correctness.rationale: Three-dimensional invariant aggregate basis and explicit characteristic polynomial of a one-phase exchange give the exact period multiplier. Hyperbolic differentiation gives strict unique temporal crossing and endpoint asymptotics. The Poincare map is monotone and strictly subhomogeneous on strictly positive states; Perron-vector upper/lower iteration establishes the globally attracting positive period orbit for multiplier above one, and strictly inhibitory Perron pairing plus maximal-orbit comparison proves extinction at or below one. Half-cycle conjugacy gives exact inactive-leaf decay and ratio. Checker passed 72 spectral and nonlinear numerical corroborations, not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A naturally defined common-hub alternating-contact population is the smallest modular temporal network separating fast-time averaged extinction from slow-time endemicity. The theorem provides a complete sharp residence-time phase diagram and two edge scales, and quantifies a directly observable endemic phase skew independent of transmission strength. The exact equality case and all-initial-state result are mathematically meaningful and distinguish this analysis from one linear stability computation.
